## Summary

Introduce the source-authored `CreatorSaveDialog` component from original checkpoint 47c7fa1.

```text
exit → frame 1 → cancel / exit callbacks
save → frame 2 → onSave → frame 3 code / frame 7 error
code → copy / return / exit / isolated unavailable-share stub
```

Verify it in an owned StrictMode fixture. The current editor's direct-save bridge remains until the following integration slice.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the archived component fails the fresh-author regression (`You` instead of source `BubbleTanks3`) and paints the down state on secondary pointer input.
  **After:** both focused cases pass; formatting, TypeScript, 519 rule/parser tests (6,299 assertions), production build and all six native/mock component cases pass in 23.3s without skips.
- Source `PlayerProfile._-ba` initializes to `BubbleTanks3`; optional `authorName` supports caller-resolved restored names. The snapshot supplies the initial tank name. Preserve whole-chunk input rejection, 20/25-character limits and source author placeholder focus behavior.
- Independently decrypt the exported AES-ECB header to verify raw difficulty1. Cover fresh/failed IDs, punctuation-preserving suffix edits, invalid paste, select-all, clipboard success/permission denial, focus trapping/restore, Cancel vs Exit, button paint and actual screenshot pixels. No external requests.
- Native/mock name and code captures were inspected. One earlier native load failed image decoding before dialog mount; unchanged focused and complete runs passed. No loader/retry workaround or cause is established.
- The share sequence uses the existing retired-service stub and error frame; account/network flow is intentionally absent. Browser keyboard/focus/clipboard adapters and full original input/text timing remain explicit limits.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

The component and dedicated styles can be removed before integration. Existing editor navigation and profile schema remain unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** dialogs

Adds a component API and isolated fixture; live editor blocking, new/loaded form defaults, preferred-author persistence and avatar/return choreography belong to the next slice.
